recentItems.title: CKWX "1130 NewsRadio Vancouver" - Last Hour & Final Sign-Off: July 7, 2026
recentItems.description:
JOIN THE BROADCAST PLAZA DISCORD TODAY! "THIS IS THE PLACE" FOR ALL THINGS BROADCASTING:  https://discord.com/invite/DrgsQQtcnS

Skip ahead to 1:15:00 for the final minute on air.

A look at the final full hour of the all news format on CKWX followed by the sign off at approximately 10:15 AM PDT on July 7, 2026, abruptly in the middle of "The Talkback Hour with David Smith", one of the few talk shows on the station. Rogers shut down five other stations across Canada on that date, including sister station CISL.

CKWX first signed on in 1923 in Nanaimo, BC and subsequently moved to Vancouver in 1925. It was one of the oldest continuously operating station in the Vancouver market.

Prior to the all news format which launched in 1996, the station also aired the following formats:
* Top 40 (1957-1962)
* Middle of the road/talk (1962-1973)
* Country (1973-1996)

recentItems.title: Rogers SHUTS DOWN 6 Radio Stations - Sign-Offs CISL CKWX CFFR CFAC CKGL & CJNI July 7, 2026
recentItems.description:
JOIN THE BROADCAST PLAZA DISCORD TODAY! "THIS IS THE PLACE" FOR ALL THINGS BROADCASTING:  https://discord.com/invite/DrgsQQtcnS

On July 7, 2026, Rogers Sports & Media announced the immediate closure of six of its news and sports station across Canada. These include:
0:00 - CISL Sportsnet 650 Vancouver (1980-2026)
0:13 - CKWX 1130 NewsRadio Vancouver (1923-2026)
0:38 - CFFR 660 NewsRadio Calgary (1984-2026)
1:03 - CFAC Sportsnet 960 The Fan (1922-2026)
1:17 - CKGL 570 NewsRadio Kitchener (1949-2026)
1:40 - CJNI-FM 95.7 NewsRadio Halifax (2005-2026)

The stations were shutdown with much fanfare. Regular programming ceased immediately was replaced with dead air and a repeating message announcing the station's closure every 15 minutes. The transmitters for all of these stations were shut down later during the day and Rogers intend to return all of these licences to the CRTC.

Rogers continues to operate CFTR 680 NewsRadio Toronto and CJCL Sportsnet 590 The Fan in Toronto.

Special thanks to Emma and lrm5000 from Broadcast Plaza for allowing me to use their recordings.

A look at the new Pixel Lens look introduced by Tegna starting in January 2026. As of March 2026, Tegna was acquired by Nexstar, but the Pixel Lens look continues to roll out to the ex-Tegna stations.

It is unknown when or if Nexstar will be launching a new look for the Tegna stations, but as of writing, it is business as usual.
